name: Royal Jest
source:
Royal Jest is the world's first ever theatrically performed visual novel! Play as our hero, a humble peasant boy, as he receives a once-in-a-lifetime invitation to the opulent royal palace. The royal family, eager to refresh their incestuous lineage, seeks a worthy suitor for the Princess...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854960/Royal_Jest/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《皇家笑话》是世界上第一部戏剧化的视觉小说！扮演我们的英雄，一个卑微的农民男孩，他收到了一生一次的邀请，前往华丽的皇宫。王室家族渴望刷新他们的乱伦血统，为公主寻找一个有价值的追求者……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854960/Royal_Jest/]Steam[/url]]
